verdict.rationale: Semgrep ships 'AI-Powered Detection'/Semgrep Assistant that auto-identifies complex logic flaws and does contextual post-processing to cut false-positive noise ~20%, and users have built LLM-based triage prioritization on top of its output. However, evidence is thin beyond marketing claims, and one report notes LLMs hallucinating Semgrep functionality, suggesting the AI layer is narrow (detection/triage) rather than broad AI-generated insights across the product.
